title: Enlarged positive-frame networks: conditional kappa = 4.171211781e-5 > 2^-15
body:
## Conditional improvement

We obtain the following conditional integer-multiplication exponent under the
inherited fixed finite-alphabet multitape and analytic assumptions:

$$
T(n)=O\!\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\boxed{\kappa=\frac{4171211781}{10^{14}}=4.171211781\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}}
$$

This is approximately **1.15% above #49's** reported
`4.123863984e-5`, comparing asymptotic exponent savings, not measured
runtime. The improvement is conditional, not an unconditional theorem.

### New construction

The bit network combines changed scalar computation DAGs with alternative
source partitions and **paid whole-chain clone operations**. Recomputed
retained-controller assignments give physical role counts **36,219** (h=23)
and **47,461** (h=25).

Unlike prior original-envelope-only implementations, this network uses the
**actual enlarged signed positive frames** and their explicitly reconstructed
orthogonal projectors in the common rational basis
`L_h = I - 4J/[3(h+3)]` on both axes. All selected physical transitions
are charged using their exact local profiles, not surrogate rank histograms.

The two-stage characteristic uses `m=575`, `N=4,073,300`,
`W=175,503,731`, rank `100,912,798,425`, deficit `1,846,900` and
maximum child width `529`. The reversed data front retains the exact
heterogeneous profile: **192,596 exceptional source pairs in 169 distinct
classes** alongside the regular pairs, with all **4,073,300** pairs accounted
for. Every copied-center transform and endpoint correction remains paid.

The exact bit-side saving is `4171385779/10^14`; the unchanged complex
saving is `717/10^7`. Exact arithmetic verifies **47 strict assembly
constraints and seven final margins**, including the inherited semantic,
resampling, routing and product-reservation charges.

### Verification and reproduction

- Two independent selected-producer/source-only reconstructions pass at h23
  and h25, with full scalar, rational-frame and physical compiler controls.
- Actual enlarged-frame projector identities and nested-space requirements
  have written rational proofs and independent checks.
- Exact heterogeneous data-rank classification covers **4,073,300 pairs**;
  CRT bounds, enough proven primes and full exceptional-profile accounting
  are retained with the source receipts.
- An independently reconstructible standard-library Python arithmetic driver,
  immutable input fixtures, source/graph recovery code, six selected-map gzip
  records and original compiler receipts are included in this PR.
- The complete original source and evidence are pinned at
  [commit 6d74d118](https://github.com/hipotures/rad/commit/6d74d1181a985b5b82debf3eb3e1a7fdbc869671).

Reproduce the exact conditional arithmetic from this PR's root:

```sh
P=research/enlarged-positive-frame-networks
python3 "$P/code/explicit_profile_composition.py" \
  --axes "$P/fixtures/mapped-positive-negative-axis-profiles.json" \
  --phase "$P/fixtures/phase-pr36.json" \
  --assembly "$P/code/adopted_pr37_balanced_assembly.py" \
  --geometry "$P/agents/geometry/results/both-negative-data-input-audit.json" \
  --data "$P/fixtures/both-negative-data-profile.json" \
  --output /tmp/enlarged-positive-frames-exact.json
```

These are finite checks and a conditional mathematical construction, **not**
formal verification or external peer review of the complete asymptotic theorem.
Inherited analytic recovery, machine/tape operations, suitable prime/native
setup and enormous eventual constants remain explicit assumptions.
